pages.title: About Us
pages.page_body:
The Daily Pulse is an independent digital newsroom bringing you fast, fair and fact-checked news from India and the world — 24×7.

Our story

The Daily Pulse started with a simple idea: truth first. every hour.. Today a passionate team carries that promise forward every day.

What we believe

  • People first
  • Quality without shortcuts
  • Honest, transparent communication

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.page_body:
The Daily Pulse respects your privacy. We collect only the information you share with us through our forms, use it only to respond to you, and never sell it.

Contact us anytime to view or delete your data.

news_posts.title: Parliament clears landmark data protection rules after marathon debate
news_posts.summary: Both Houses passed the rules late on Wednesday, giving citizens new rights over how their personal data is collected and used.
news_posts.body:
New Delhi: Both Houses passed the rules late on Wednesday, giving citizens new rights over how their personal data is collected and used.

Under the new rules, companies must take clear consent before collecting personal data and delete it once the purpose is served.

The development was confirmed by officials on Thursday evening, and a detailed notification is expected within the week.

Experts say the move could have a far-reaching impact over the next few years, though several questions about implementation remain open.

Stakeholders have welcomed the step but asked for clear timelines and regular public updates on progress.

blogs.title: Why local news still matters
blogs.author: Editor's Desk
blogs.summary: In an age of endless feeds, trusted local reporting is more important than ever.
blogs.body:
In an age of endless feeds, trusted local reporting is more important than ever.

Local journalists are often the first to spot problems — from broken roads to unpaid wages — and the last to leave a story.
